candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order (/v1/orders) hits a transport ReadTimeout; order's own call to payment (/v1/authorizations) also ReadTimeouts, while inventory/redis reservations succeed quickly, indicating slow downstream payment/order path.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment ReadTimeout but no payment-side spans/metrics; cannot confirm whether payment itself is slow or order's client timeout is misconfigured.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with ~2s transport ReadTimeouts on gateway->order and order->payment, while inventory/redis succeed. Bounded to downstream latency on the order/payment path; payment-side telemetry is missing to localize further.
